limitations: N09-01 is additive contracts and a deterministic in-memory reference model only. No runtime admission route, global grant allocator, migration, room hook, client queue or activation is introduced.

No PostgreSQL atomicity/race/restart/lease-janitor or actual room-admission acceptance is claimed. Authenticated actor binding, durable receipts, request-version validation, SQL locking/fencing and owner reconciliation belong to N09-02.

The model clock and new identifiers are trusted allocator inputs, never client timestamps or actor claims. ACTIVE is conservatively retained until authoritative release; TTL alone cannot silently forget an active room player.
Queue pause stops new offers; existing counted reservations/grace can transition without another slot. Runtime maintenance/safety/entitlement and session revocation remain independent stronger gates.

Policy/queue/TTL numeric ceilings and synthetic caps are validation/model parameters, not sustainable CCU, recommended production capacity or authorization to raise a real cap. N08/N09-04 evidence gates remain.
